_meta.purpose: Legal and illegal capability-descriptor combinations with the expected validation result for each, per freeze section 3.

descriptor_fields.contract_verified: official page fetched + literal version + schema recorded
descriptor_fields.adapter_built: code exists at its frozen path
descriptor_fields.offline_tests_passed: the operation's fixture test is green
descriptor_fields.read_verified: one authorized read returned 200 in the target tenant
descriptor_fields.canary_verified: one authorized, approved write proven by readback
descriptor_fields.enabled: bool; default False for every operation at freeze

rules.text: Default for every operation at freeze: enabled = False.
Read operations may be enabled only when contract_verified AND adapter_built AND offline_tests_passed AND read_verified.
Write operations may be enabled only when rule 2 holds and canary_verified.

Every V4 workflow write is DISABLED until enabled by evidence, and additionally requires a production contract page, the supported-version table listing v4, and an explicit approval token on every call. Staging documentation can set contract_verified=True; it can never set read_verified or canary_verified.
enabled = True together with activation_blocked != None is a contract violation; the test asserts it is impossible for any row.
Enablement is per (operation_id, tenant). A global enabled flag computed from docs alone is forbidden.
The gate refuses before transport with status=denied, error.rule=capability_disabled, and echoes the descriptor. A disabled call still produces a receipt.
Internal/private rows (skill44_private) are not governed by this gate.
Skill 06 authoring rows are not HTTP operations and carry no capability descriptor.

activation_blocked.reason: Version/auth acceptance in the target tenant not proven
activation_blocked.unblock: one authorized read per operation, exact header, 200 recorded; 401/403 distinguishes scope vs edge

expected.note: Default state; a call is refused before transport with status=denied, error.rule=capability_disabled, and still produces a receipt.
Legal combination: disabled with no blocker (registry blocker NONE). This row is excluded from adapter scope (YAGNI) and is used only to exercise the legal no-blocker state.
Rule 3.2.2 satisfied: read operation may be enabled without canary_verified.
Rule 3.2.3 satisfied: write operation enabled with canary evidence.

activation_blocked.reason: v4 is staging-only; absent from the supported list
activation_blocked.unblock: production page and the supported-version table listing v4

expected.note: enabled = True together with activation_blocked != None is impossible for any row.
A global enabled flag computed from docs alone is forbidden (3.2.6); enablement is per (operation_id, tenant).
A write may be enabled only when the read rule holds and canary_verified is true.
Staging documentation can set contract_verified=True; it can never set read_verified, canary_verified or enabled (3.2.4, 3.2.6).

activation_blocked.reason: v4 is staging-only; absent from the supported list
activation_blocked.unblock: production page and the supported-version table listing v4

expected.note: Staging documentation may set contract_verified=True while the row stays disabled (3.2.4).
